head: 2b544355f (UI code from wip sync f0eb3ef00; prod client built by probe_match_memory from the working tree at about 13:44 into _harness/_prod/client/dist, which also held the audio lane's uncommitted src/audio edits)
summary: UI-5 passes. UI-6 fails: the match start transient is still there in the production client. BRIDGE was +132 MB and the second RIFT +159 MB at the 1 s reading (first 20 s max minus steady max). That is in the same range as round 5 (+120..+221), so the code change does not measurably release the loading raster at the match's first frame. The required measurement is valid as memory (load 5-45 at the start readings), but the probe's gate still says NOT MEASURED (load max 137, 40 of 40 readings busy). No regressions: typecheck 0, content:check 0 warnings, npm run -s probe 55/55, e2e flow PASS, e2e bridge PASS.

items.evidence: content/strings.en.json:680-681 has hud.menu.button_tip and hud.menu.button_sub. Their text matches the cv.t fallbacks at src/ui/hud/index.tsx:203/205 byte for byte. `grep -rn hud.menu src` lists 8 keys, and all 8 are in strings.en.json. strings.en.json is the only locale file. `npm run content:check` reports 'OK (check only, nothing written): 0 warnings' and exits 0. Note, not blocking: the tip text hardcodes 'Esc' while the keycap uses keyShort('Escape'), which is fine as long as Esc cannot be rebound.

Code reviewed: app.tsx ScreenHost drops every layer when entering a match route, state.ts makes the match reset a cut ('none'), and loading.tsx clears img src in a layout-effect cleanup (the ref survives Preact's null). Correct and harmless. The brief's goal is not met. Command: heavy.py run -- node _harness/probe_match_memory.mjs --modes rift,bridge,rift --sec 120 --raw-cdp --full-scale --fake-audio --track --out _harness/_reports/fw_r6_ui_v1_start_high.json (log .log). BRIDGE: 1 s reading 2459 MB (renderer 757, GPU 1702), 14 s reading 2183 (569/1614), steady max 2327, so transient +132; renderer -188 and GPU -88 from 1 s to 14 s, while GL textures were flat (1088 -> 1091) and tracked audio flat (151.8 -> 153 MB). RIFT #2: 1 s 2606 (724/1882), 14 s 2442 (693/1749), steady max 2447, transient +159, GPU -133. Round 5 baselines with the same method (fw_r5_mem_rf_high4): +124/+120/+221/+159. The author's own A/B (fw_r6_ui_base_diag vs fw_r6_ui_fix1_diag) also shows only +287 -> +251 / +247 -> +244. The peak of every BRIDGE and RIFT #2 match is still the 1 s reading. RIFT #1's first reading came at 2 s (2320, renderer 645, already near steady), giving -135. That fits the author's finding that Chrome frees the loading surplus 1.5-2 s in. In the player's terms the raster is not released 'as soon as the match's first frame shows'.

Re-measured myself (see UI-6): transients RIFT/BRIDGE/RIFT = -135 (missed the window, first poll at 2 s) / +132 / +159. Loads at the 1 s readings: 5.5 / 45.6 / 14.3. Memory readings are valid at this load, but the probe gate says 'GATE NOT MEASURED: needs idle machine (load max 137.46, 40 of 40 readings busy); would pass'. Peaks 2455/2459/2606 MB are under the 3000 bar. Homes 783/884/1145/1211/1212 are under 2500. The author's run (fw_r6_ui_start_high.json, -96/-56/-175, first polls at 1/9/9 s, load to 225) is invalid for the transient, as they stated. Harness note: under heavy.py run the probe's heavyOthers() counts the heavy.py wrapper's own slot (wrapper pid != process.pid), so the gate can never read 'idle' when queued as the rules require.

`npm run -s typecheck` exits 0. `npm run content:check` exits 0 with 0 warnings. `npm run -s probe`: 55 passed, 0 failed (226.4 s). `heavy.py run -- node _harness/e2e.mjs flow`: PASS (flow_dodge:ok flow_readycheck:ok flow_netdown:ok), _harness/_reports/fw_r6_ui_v1_e2e_flow.json. `heavy.py run -- node _harness/e2e.mjs bridge --out _harness/_reports/fw_r6_ui_v1_e2e_bridge.json`: PASS (bridge:ok store:ok), with loading -> route 'match' and home_again ok. The other entries into a match route were reviewed: Settings -> back to the match already cut with 'none' before this change, so dropping the leaving layer in the same commit changes nothing visible. Non-match routes keep their leave transitions. src/sim untouched, no content ids added to src.

next: UI-6 needs a change that actually removes the ~1-2 s loading surplus (e.g. lighter loading-card splash variants instead of 1600x900 webp, which is an art/content handoff), or an owner ruling that excludes the first ~2 s from the start-transient bar. Fix the probe's own-slot detection so the gate can read idle under heavy.py.
